hero.slogan: One Pure Thought, One Mala Bead
hero.subtitle: Every Bead a Meditation

steps.title: Choose
steps.step1_desc: Select from natural wood, crystal, and agate — feel the warmth and energy of each material
steps.step2_desc: Freely combine spacer beads, tassels, and pendants to tell your story
steps.step3_desc: Preview your mala in 3D, then our artisans handcraft it for you

materials.title: Quality
materials.mat1_desc1: Harvested from Southeast Asia, dense and hardy
materials.mat1_desc2: Fine grain with a deep copper hue
materials.mat1_desc3: Hand-polished to 2000 grit by master craftsmen
materials.mat1_desc4: Smooth and warm to the touch, like jade
materials.mat2_desc2: Translucent as ice, with natural fissures

story.title: Stillness
story.line1: Every mala is a testament to practice.
story.line2: The very act of hand-polishing each bead is a form of cultivation.
story.line3: From selection to stringing, from polishing to blessing — every step is taken with awareness and reverence.
story.verse: Master things, not be mastered by them
